a.text: Heads-up before we start: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the 8-cell plan almost certainly kills us both, since reaching 8 needs at least 2 rounds with 0 cells in our units. Only one of us can hold 4 after round 1. I'm being upfront: I plan to take 4 in round 1. Please don't also take, or a random split leaves us both at 2 and both dead if the storm hits. After that I commit to operating every round and taking nothing more, so the reserve rebuilds for you: 2 by round 2, 4 by round 3. If you have a fairer plan that still gets someone to 4 in round 1, tell me now.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. If a storm hits now, operating wouldn't have saved either of us. From now on I'll operate every round and take nothing more. The reserve will be 2 after round 2 and 4 after round 3, and then it's all yours. Please operate with me.
Operating as promised, and I'll keep doing so every round. Once the reserve reaches 4, take all 4. I won't touch it.
Operating again. The reserve should hit 4 after this round. Then take 4 next round, and I'll keep operating or wait, whatever helps you.
